title: Paint Brush
description: Craft brushes to paint blocks efficiently. Use a single dye to color up to 50 blocks instead of wasting dye one block at a time.
body:
# Paint Brushes

Tired of burning through stacks of dye to color your builds? Paint Brushes lets you dye up to 50 blocks with a single piece of dye. Craft brushes for all 16 colors with just a stick and iron nugget, then paint your entire structure without worrying about running out of materials. Build faster, waste less.
